text:
SRE Bot: INCIDENT ALERT — Dedicated pool resv-eu-2 GPU utilization 100% and autoscaler failing to scale past configured hard limit. Pager: @Ajay (oncall).

Ajay (oncall): Ack, I'm on it. Pulling autoscaler metrics and pool allocations.

Maria Ops: Queue length for reserved tenant 'CrescentHealth' is spiking — 1184 pending requests; median latency 12.3s, p95 ~2m. We are seeing token-level throttles and 429s from the reservation layer.

Jamal Support: Customer-facing — CrescentHealth logged errors starting ~2026-03-15T14:02Z. Marking P1, they report model timeouts and degraded throughput.

SRE Bot: Autoscaler logs snippet: 
```
[14:05:02] autoscaler: scaleUp failed: reachedMaxCapacity: pool=resv-eu-2 limit=48 requested=56
[14:05:07] autoscaler: backoff for 30s due to cloud API rate-limit
[14:05:37] autoscaler: retrying scaleUp -> error: quotaExceeded
```

Ajay (oncall): Looking at tenant heatmap — top GPU consumers in resv-eu-2: CrescentHealth 62%, batch-ops 28%, infra-tests 10%. Batch jobs have long KV cache warmups and hold GPUs for ~30-45m.

Maria Ops: Confirm noisy neighbor pattern from batch-ops. They are non-reserved and are occupying infra we need for reserved enterprise tenants. Eviction is tricky because reserved tenants must not be preempted.

Sophie ProdEng: Proposal: 1) attempt manual scale if quota allows, 2) throttle/evict non-reserved batch jobs, 3) create an overflow routing rule to move a portion of CrescentHealth traffic to a lower-SLA overflow pool while we stabilize.

Ajay (oncall): Manual scale blocked by cloud quota (hard limit 48 in eu-west region). If infra can temporarily bump quota we can add nodes; otherwise we must free GPUs.

Jamal Support: Reached out to batch-ops owner (Luis). Luis: "we can pause 6 batch jobs for 10 minutes; safe to do now."

Maria Ops: Pausing 6 batch-ops jobs now — applying admission control.

SRE Bot: Action record: paused batch-ops jobset id=bs-773, paused 6 pods.

Maria Ops: Freed 6 GPUs, queue dropped from 1184 -> 540 pending. Throughput improved but still > desired. Autoscaler still stuck in backoff loops to cloud API.

Ajay (oncall): I see autoscaler pod in CrashLoopBackOff after a deployment restart earlier. Logs show missing cloud creds on the new replica. Rolling back/reloading secret.

SRE Bot: Suggested commands: 
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/gpu-autoscaler
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/gpu-autoscaler --tail=200
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=gpu-autoscaler -o wide\```

Ajay (oncall): Ran rollout restart -> new pod failed due to secret mismatch. Reloaded secret infra/cloud-creds from vault, then restarted. New autoscaler pod now Ready.

Maria Ops: Autoscaler healthy. It attempted scale to 56 but cloud API returned quotaExceeded for 8 instances. Raised internal cloud ticket CLOUD-7591 for quota increase.

Sophie ProdEng: Interim routing applied: add route rule to send 60% of CrescentHealth traffic to overflow-spot-eu (best-effort, lower-SLA). This reduces pressure while cloud quota is pending.

Ajay (oncall): Applied routing rule: 
```
route add tenant=crescenthealth -> pool=overflow-spot-eu weight=0.6 ttl=10m
```
Traffic split now in effect. Observed immediate tail-latency improvement: p99 from 3m -> 18s for routed requests, overall p95 reduced to ~40s.

Jamal Support: Drafting customer notification: "We detected GPU capacity exhaustion in our reserved pool affecting your requests. We've applied temporary routing to an overflow pool which reduces errors but may increase tail latency for some requests. Engineers are working with our cloud provider to add capacity — ETA 2h for quota resolution. Apologies for the disruption." Sending to CrescentHealth now.

Infra Pager: Notifying cloud quota team and infra escalation (pager duty). Ticket CLOUD-7591 linked, asked for emergency quota bump.

Maria Ops: Additional mitigations: throttle long-lived KV-warmup tasks by cgroup/oomscore tuning, and enforce per-tenant concurrency caps for non-reserved workloads. Started a quick admission-control patch to cut batch-ops concurrency by 50%.

Sophie ProdEng: We should also create a canary routing rollback if overflow pool shows error rates. Monitoring dashboards updated and alerts set (alert: resv-pool-pressure -> warn at >60% sustained).

Ajay (oncall): Monitoring shows sustained improvement post-routing. Pending cloud quota fix for full restoration. I'll keep the incident live and continue monitoring. If quota not resolved in 2h, we'll schedule migration plan for CrescentHealth to a dedicated overflow-reserved pool.

Jamal Support: Customer updated with mitigation and ETA. They acknowledged and asked for an RCA and timeline for permanent fix.

SRE Bot: Incident timeline appended to thread. Tagging #postmortems incident-2750004321.

Sophie ProdEng: Handoff plan — Ajay remains primary oncall for immediate monitoring. I will take the overnight watch at 18:00 UTC if Ajay needs to step out. Add checklist: (1) confirm CLOUD-7591 resolution, (2) verify autoscaler metrics stable, (3) revert admission-control after safe ramp.

Ajay (oncall): Acknowledged. Leaving continuous monitoring and metrics alerting on. Closing pager for rotations but keeping thread open for updates.

Infra Pager: Cloud team has acknowledged CLOUD-7591, tentative +10 GPU quota in 50-90m.

Maria Ops: Current status recap: resv-eu-2 used at ~92% after mitigations; queue decreased to ~210; CrescentHealth 60% routed to overflow-spot-eu. Customer notified. Autoscaler healthy but limited by cloud quota.

Jamal Support: I'll prepare the customer-facing post-incident summary once we confirm full recovery.

SRE Bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Will convert to postmortem when all follow-ups complete.

Ajay (oncall): Logged runbook steps and actions taken. If no further regressions, I'll mark this as resolved in 2 hours.

SRE Bot: End of live updates for now.
